summary: Iter40 fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 54/54 PASS combined (iter32 white-label 22, iter34 pay-now 10, iter39 admin-fees 10, NEW iter40 12). New iter40 test file covers: /pro-invoices/templates/list returns exactly 4 keys WITHOUT description field; legacy template keys (classic/modern/minimalist/bold/elegant) auto-migrate AND render valid PDFs (>2KB); POST /pay-link/{id}/share-in-conversation success path inserts db.messages doc with 'Zahlungslink für Rechnung' + creates db.notifications {kind:'pay_link_shared'} for the homeowner; 400 when pay-link disabled; 404 for unknown invoice; 403/404 for homeowner; PATCH /api/admin/fees/{id} with status=cancelled writes notification {kind:'fee_cancelled', link_to:'/billing'}; amount change writes {kind:'fee_adjusted', body contains old €X.XX and new €X.XX + reason snippet + job_id[:8]}. Frontend: ProSettings → Invoice details shows exactly 4 testids (template-preview-minimal_artisan/creative_bold/small_business/medical); old description strings ('Conservative typography', 'Heavy black', 'Italic accents', 'Bold display', 'Clean and modern') NOT present; help text now says 'pick from 4 templates' (no '5 templates'). MyInvoices: 51 'Online payment' buttons confirmed, no 'Add payment' label; PayDialog (myinv-payments-modal) opens with pay-link section including [myinv-paylink-toggle], copy/open icons, and [myinv-paylink-share-chat] button visible when link enabled — clicking the toggle disables the link and hides the share button as expected. Mobile (390x844): tabs render above search input (visually confirmed via screenshot). Wide (1440x900): search is on the right side at x=912, tabs on left — no overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: payment_link_routes.py share_pay_link_in_conversation: when PUBLIC_APP_URL/FRONTEND_URL env vars are unset, the pay_url falls back to a RELATIVE '/pay/{token}' path inside the WhatsApp/in-app message — the homeowner cannot click that as a real URL outside the app. Confirm PUBLIC_APP_URL is set in production env or change fallback to an explicit error/inline-route hint.

share_pay_link_in_conversation does NOT update db.conversations.last_message_at / unread_count for the homeowner (other share endpoints typically do). The recipient may see a stale 'last activity' until they open the thread — acceptable since the bell notification also fires, but worth a TODO.

admin_advanced_routes.py PATCH /fees/{id}: the notification body uses fee['job_id'][:8] — for fee rows whose job_id is None (e.g. legacy fees) this would throw TypeError. Wrap with str(fee.get('job_id') or '')[:8].

pro_invoices.user_id is stored as STRING in DB, but messages.from_id / messages.to_id / notifications.user_id in share_pay_link_in_conversation are coerced to ObjectId — this asymmetry is OK because consumers tolerate both, but document/standardize one format across all collections to prevent future joins from breaking.
seed_data_creation: Inserted+deleted 2 fee_log rows + 2 notifications during fee PATCH tests (cleaned in same test). Created 1 message + 1 notification doc during share-in-conversation test (NOT cleaned — represents legitimate in-app message for homeowner Anna Müller, harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter40 verified end-to-end. Note: pro_profiles.user_id is stored as STRING (not ObjectId) — when writing tests that query pro_profiles, use {'user_id': str(user_id)}. Pay-link is currently ENABLED on RG-2026-0081 (Anna Müller). Frontend route for pro settings is /settings (NOT /pro-settings). Active testids confirmed: template-preview-{minimal_artisan,creative_bold,small_business,medical}, pro-settings-tab-invoice_details, myinv-online-payment-{id}, myinv-payments-modal, myinv-paylink-toggle, myinv-paylink-share-chat. The 4 template PDFs all render >2KB with new visuals (visual regression out of scope).
